title: Chapter 15 Daxia Territory
content:
Chapter 15 Daxia Territory

"Don't worry, the lord has given this territory to me, and I am now the lord of this territory."

"From now on, the Red Earth Territory will be renamed the Great Xia Territory!"

Wu Qing sat calmly in his original position without moving, and said to Hu Tu with a smile.

Hu Tu stopped at the door, as if seeing something strange, with a look of disbelief on his face.

He waited for a while and then confirmed in a low voice: "Brother Wu is really a lord now?"

Wu Qing nodded and said: "Of course, there is nothing strange about a lord."

Hu Tu walked forward excitedly, performed a chest-supporting salute, and said respectfully: "Hu Tu pays homage to the lord!"

Wu Qing looked solemn and said seriously: "Forget it this time, you don't have to be so respectful in the future. Respect should be kept in your heart, don't talk about it all the time."

"Since you keep calling me eldest brother, I will recognize you as my younger brother."

After hearing this, Hu Tu was so excited that he couldn't speak. He just responded: "Yes!"

"Hu Tu, go and tell everyone not to panic. Keep everything as is. I will order the Zerg to enter the city to maintain order."

After all, Hu Tu was young and didn't have many thoughts. He only knew that he suddenly became the lord's younger brother. His identity and status were different, and he needed to go out and share his joy.

"I'm going right away!"

Two puppies followed Hu Tu and left with him.

The news of the change of lord spread throughout the small town in an instant.

The Zerg troops quietly entered the city and began to garrison important positions.

Wu Qing didn't care about this for the time being. He was getting familiar with the lord's responsibilities.

He didn't know how other lords managed their territories. The lord management interface he saw now after system transformation was very simple.

There is a very abstract map where you can choose the scope of your territory and control the core area where the lord protects you.

The adjustment of the territory scope and the core area of lord protection is based on the territory having sufficient luck.

The increase or decrease in luck is related to the development of the territory. As long as there is enough luck, the territory can expand without limit.

What is the luck of the territory? The system is not digitized. It may not comply with the rules of this world.

It turns out that the lord's core sanctuary area in the Red Earth Territory is only large enough to cover the entire small city. After leaving the city, you enter the weakened area of the lord's sanctuary. Many weird things can move in the weakened area, which will be very dangerous at night.

The entire territory is not large, just all the areas that have been cultivated.

It can be seen from this that the kobold lord really came to lie down, and the development of the territory was very poor.

Now, after some troubles by the former lord, the population of the entire territory is only just over 2,000, and many families have lost the backbone of their families, leaving Wu Qing with a mess.

Of course, lords have benefits. The territory's luck increases. If the lord receives luck blessings, he can easily improve his strength and break through bottlenecks.

Luck also has many functions. The lord can use the luck of the territory within a certain range.

It can be said that a powerful enough lord, as long as he is willing, can easily become the son of destiny in this world and be favored by the will of the world.

"It turns out that the breakthrough in strength in this world has been suppressed by the will of the world. Is everything related to luck?"

"Why do lords, gods, luck, and faith suddenly feel familiar?"

Wu Qing did not change other settings of the territory, but changed the name from Red Earth Territory to Daxia Territory.

The name of Daxia has finally officially appeared on the stage of this world.

…

Outside the lord's castle, the commotion caused by the departure of the former lord quickly stabilized under the influence of the dual factors of Hu Tu's propaganda and the Zerg's entry into the city.

"Why did the lord suddenly change? What happened?"

"Who knows? No matter who becomes the lord, our lives will still be the same, and what is supposed to happen will always come."

"No! I'll leave early tomorrow morning! The identity of the lord is not simple. He has given up this territory, and he will definitely not be able to stay here anymore!"

"The results are the same wherever you go, so why take the risk? If you can survive for a day, you will make a day."

"..."

Through the sensitive hearing of the Zerg, Wu Qing heard the whispers in various places in the city. From these conversations, he could see many problems.

"It's not easy for people in this world to live."

Wu Qing had to sigh.

People living at the bottom of this world take life and death very lightly. Just the day before yesterday, a lot of young people in this city died.

The people in the city didn't pay much attention to this, and no one blamed the former lord for sending his family to die.

From everyone's conversations, it can be heard that most people have a survival attitude and live one day at a time.

"How can native creatures with this mental state defeat foreign races with fanatical beliefs?"

Wu Qing seems to have seen the final outcome of this world.

"I hope the situation in other territories will be better."

Wu Qing no longer thought about it.

He has a basic understanding of the territory and is about to start working.

The managers of the entire territory were taken away by the former lord, and the territory is now in a state of paralysis.

These problems are not difficult for Wu Qing. He has lived in the world and has seen various management models. It is not difficult to manage such a small territory with 2,000 people and the support of the Zerg.

Wu Qing transferred 10 hosts to the city. The huge hosts hovered over the territory, arousing everyone's curiosity.

The host has strong spiritual power and can communicate with local creatures on a spiritual level.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading!

Wu Qing can use the host to issue notices and orders to the people in the entire territory.

10 hosts are in place, and a neutral voice sounded in the minds of all the people in the territory.

"The new lord announced that the Red Earth Territory has been renamed the Great Xia Territory."

People were surprised to find the source of the voice, wanting to confirm whether the news was true.

"Great Xia Territory? We have become the Great Xia Territory?"

"Who is talking? Did you hear it?"

"I heard it too, it seems like someone is talking in my ear!"

"No, someone is talking in my heart!"

"It's amazing! Are these new big guys?"

Some smart people connected this voice with the host who just arrived.

"The lord issues the first order, a call for talents."

"Anyone who is confident in their ability in a certain area, regardless of their identity, can go to the call for talents hall in the lord's castle to register for assessment."

"Those who pass the assessment will become the lord's direct subordinates and participate in the management and construction of the territory."

The call for talents issued by Wu Qing instantly set off a storm in the territory.

He actually does not need talented people to manage the territory. As the queen of the Zerg collective consciousness, she can be regarded as an authentic biological super brain.

As long as Wu Qing instills some core management ideas into it and lets it manage a small territory, it is really a waste of talent.

The purpose of Wu Qing's call for talents is just to find people in the territory who have their own ideas like Hu Tu. Those who just want to survive in the world are not of much value for the time being.
